decisions.statement: The boot settings are read by `parse-boot-env`.
Boot settings that will not parse are written to the refusal seam.
A refusal written on boot ends with a newline.
Boot settings that will not parse exit the process with code 1.
A refused boot starts no gateway.
A refused boot writes no proxy state.
The console is redirected before the gateway is started.
The console redirection is told the log directory the boot settings name.
The console redirection is told the agent the boot settings name.
A gateway is started with the port the boot settings name.
A gateway is started with the root handed in.
A gateway is started with the log prefix `[oauth-proxy]`.
A gateway is started with the idle span the boot settings name.
A gateway is started with the keepalive span the boot settings name.
A gateway is started with the socket path answered for the agent.
The log directory reaches the start options as a call rather than a path.
A gateway is started with the subagents the following seam holds as stopped.
The following is started before the gateway is started.
A process handed no following seam starts a gateway holding no subagent as stopped.
Going down stops the following after the gateway is stopped.
The proxy state written names the process id.
The proxy state written names the port the gateway bound.
The proxy state written names the version the boot settings name.
The port the gateway bound is printed with a newline.
The port is printed after the proxy state is written.
SIGTERM takes the process down.
SIGINT takes the process down.
A second signal takes nothing further down.
Going down flushes the gateway before the gateway is stopped.
Going down stops the gateway before the proxy state is cleared.
A flush that throws still leaves the gateway stopped.
A stop that throws still leaves the proxy state cleared.
A clearing that throws still leaves the process exiting.
Anything thrown while going down is written about on the throw seam.
Going down waits on the transport rows reaching the disk.
The transport wait is reached after the proxy state is cleared.
A transport wait that throws still leaves the process exiting.
Going down exits the process with code 0.
A caller hands in the environment the boot settings are read from.
A caller hands in the act a signal is listened for by.
Nothing here binds a port.
Nothing here answers a request.
Nothing here reads an account.
Nothing here reads a token.
Nothing here reads a clock.
Nothing here spawns a process.
The root is handed in rather than parsed out of the environment.
The registration account the boot settings name is read by nothing here.
No refresh outcome hook reaches the gateway this process starts.
No terminal test reaches the gateway this process starts.
No transport log path reaches the gateway this process starts.
The health writing the old entrypoint did on a refresh is carried nowhere.
A signal arriving before the signal listeners are set is caught by nothing.
The console redirection is one seam rather than the sinks that redirection is made of.
Nothing under this domain spawns the process this module describes.
The exit is a seam so nothing here proves the process really ends.
The old entrypoint at `tools/lib/model-gateway/main.ts` exits before a row lands.

definition: the process a gateway runs as from its boot to the signal ending that process
